001package services;
002
003import comparators.StudentComparators;
004import models.Course;
005import models.Mark;
006import models.Student;
007import models.Teacher;
008import models.Transcript;
009
010import java.util.ArrayList;
011import java.util.Collections;
012import java.util.List;
013
014/** Grading, transcripts, academic reports, and teacher ratings. */
015public class MarkService {
016    private static MarkService instance;
017    private final Database db = Database.getInstance();
018
019    private MarkService() {}
020
021    public static MarkService getInstance() {
022        if (instance == null) instance = new MarkService();
023        return instance;
024    }
025
026    public void putMark(Student s, Course c, float att1, float att2, float fin) {
027        if (s == null || c == null) return;
028        Mark mark = new Mark(Math.round(att1), Math.round(att2), Math.round(fin), s, c);
029        s.addMark(mark);
030        db.save();
031    }
032
033    public Transcript getTranscript(Student s) {
034        if (s == null) return null;
035        return s.getTranscript();
036    }
037
038    public void generateAcademicReport(Student s) {
039        if (s == null) return;
040        System.out.println("=== Academic report for " + s.getName() + " (" + s.getLogin() + ") ===");
041        for (Course c : s.getEnrolledCourseObjects()) {
042            Mark m = s.getMarkForCourse(c);
043            System.out.println("- " + c.getCourseID() + ": " + (m == null ? "N/A" : (m.getLetterGrade() + " (" + m.getTotal() + ")")));
044        }
045        System.out.println(s.getTranscript());
046    }
047
048    public void generateAcademicReportForCourse(Course c) {
049        if (c == null) return;
050        System.out.println("=== Course report for " + c.getCourseID() + " ===");
051        for (Student s : c.getStudents()) {
052            Mark m = s.getMarkForCourse(c);
053            System.out.println("- " + s.getLogin() + " " + s.getName() + ": " + (m == null ? "N/A" : (m.getLetterGrade() + " (" + m.getTotal() + ")")));
054        }
055    }
056
057    public float getAverageGpa(Course c) {
058        if (c == null) return 0f;
059        if (c.getStudents().isEmpty()) return 0f;
060        double sum = 0.0;
061        for (Student s : c.getStudents()) sum += s.getTranscript().getGpa();
062        return (float) (sum / c.getStudents().size());
063    }
064
065    public List<Student> getTopStudents(int n) {
066        if (n <= 0) return Collections.emptyList();
067        List<Student> students = new ArrayList<>();
068        for (base.User u : db.getUsersByRole(enums.Role.STUDENT)) {
069            students.add((Student) u);
070        }
071        students.sort(StudentComparators.BY_GPA_DESC);
072        if (students.size() <= n) return students;
073        return new ArrayList<>(students.subList(0, n));
074    }
075
076    public void rateTeacher(Student student, Teacher teacher, int rate) {
077        if (student == null || teacher == null) return;
078        if (rate < 1 || rate > 5) return;
079        String key = student.getId() + "::" + teacher.getId();
080        if (db.teacherRatings.containsKey(key)) return; // once per student
081        db.teacherRatings.put(key, rate);
082        db.save();
083    }
084}
